name: Dimitri Volkov
bio: Dimitri's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. A skilled handyman from a young age, he initially worked repairing fishing boats in his hometown near the Volga River. When a local racing team needed someone to fix crash damage on their composite bodywork, Dimitri's knack for repairs and attention to detail caught their eye. He quickly transitioned from boats to racing cars, learning the intricacies of carbon fiber and other advanced materials. Although relatively new to the highest levels of motorsport, Dimitri possesses a strong work ethic and is eager to master the latest composite technologies. His hands-on approach and dedication to quality make him a valuable asset, despite his lack of formal racing experience.

physical.description: Dimitri is of average height with a slightly stocky build, reflecting years of physical labor.

quirks: Always carries a small piece of birch bark for good luck.
Meticulously cleans his tools after every use, regardless of how tired he is.
Tends to hum traditional Russian folk songs while working.
